# Yuga Spark

> The official Hackathon & Innovation Club portal of RGMCET (Rajeev Gandhi Memorial College of Engineering & Technology), Department of Data Science.

Yuga Spark is a campus innovation platform that powers hackathon teams, squad formation, leaderboards, playbooks, certificates, and event management for the RGMCET hackathon club.

## About

- **Organization**: RGMCET (Autonomous), Nandyal, Andhra Pradesh, India
- **Department**: Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science)
- **Tagline**: "Where there is data — There is data Science"
- **Website**: https://yuga-spark.vercel.app
- **Developers**: Jaya Krushna and Hemanth

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://yuga-spark.vercel.app/): Landing page with hero section, club capabilities overview, squad finder, leaderboard preview, and club legacy showcase
- [Achievements](https://yuga-spark.vercel.app/achievements): Club achievements, hackathon podium finishes, event photo gallery, and lead teams through the years
- [Sign In](https://yuga-spark.vercel.app/auth): Authentication page for club members to access the portal

## Portal Features (Authenticated)

The following features are available to signed-in club members:

- **Dashboard**: Personal activity overview and quick stats
- **Squads**: Form and manage multi-disciplinary hackathon teams across CSE and ECE branches
- **Leaderboard**: Club-wide rankings based on participation and achievements
- **Playbook**: Resources, guides, and hackathon preparation materials
- **Notices**: Club announcements and event notifications
- **Certificates**: Digital certificates for hackathon participation and wins
- **Badges**: Achievement badges earned through club activities
- **Chat**: Club communication channel
- **Admin Panel**: Administrative tools for club leads and faculty

## Capabilities

- Squad Formation: Connect frontend developers, AI/ML engineers, and UI designers across branches
- Hackathon Tracking: Discover hackathons and track participation
- Attendance: Real-time Saturday sprint attendance tracking
- Leaderboard: Points-based ranking system for club members
- Certificate Generation: Digital certificates for events and achievements
- Event Management: Club notices, announcements, and event coordination
